accepted_result.required_condition: CPU state images used as GPU init-state must be sanitized with --sanitize-host-only-internals before upload

accepted_claim: For this prefill/decode paged KV-cache RTL harness, resident_steps with sanitized CPU init-state reduces the weak 1x32 repeated decode wall time while preserving coverage-output equivalence.
weakest_point_after_review: The workload now covers prefill/decode and resident repeated decode behavior, but it still uses full-width synthetic key/value words. Modern LLM serving also depends on quantized or compressed KV-cache data paths and scale metadata.

selected_next_gap.reason: Quantized KV-cache is the next smallest serving-relevant RTL gap after resident decode overhead is addressed; it adds low-precision storage/dequant-like behavior without jumping to full MHA or model-level inference.

rejected_next_gaps_for_now.reason: Larger dependency and integration surface; useful later, but quantized KV-cache is a narrower serving-specific gap.
Would mostly broaden the already-fast many-state class rather than add a missing LLM serving datapath feature.

claim_scope: review of one resident prefill/decode repeated-state benchmark result
non_claims: not low-precision or compressed KV cache yet
